title: Number of Substrings Containing All Three Characters
summary: For a string s made up of characters a, b, and c, count the substrings that include at least one of each character.
statement: For a string s made up of characters a, b, and c, count the substrings that include at least one of each character.
constraints: s contains only a, b, and c.
Count contiguous substrings containing at least one of each.
reference_solution:
def substrings_containing_abc(s):
 last={'a':-1,'b':-1,'c':-1};answer=0
 for i,char in enumerate(s):last[char]=i;answer+=min(last.values())+1
 return answer

def substrings_containing_abc(s):
 last={'a':0,'b':0,'c':0};answer=0

 return answer
hints: Track the most recent index of a, b, and c.
At each right endpoint, valid starts run from zero through the minimum last index.
Add min(last)+1, which is zero until all letters have appeared.
A start no later than every last occurrence includes all three; later starts miss the earliest one.
editorial: A start no later than every last occurrence includes all three; later starts miss the earliest one.

tests.explanation: Ten substrings contain all three letters.
Only substrings ending after both c and b and starting early enough qualify.
